name: Avatar
description: Round (or square) picture of a person or workspace, with initials that show when there's no image or it fails to load.

classes.ayy-avatar__image: The . Covers the initials when it loads.

default.looks: A disc in wash-hover with text-soft semibold initials under the image. square uses a rounded square.

hover.none: An avatar isn't a control; wrap it in a Button or link to make it one.

pressed.none: An avatar isn't a control; wrap it in a Button or link to make it one.

disabled.none: An avatar isn't a control; wrap it in a Button or link to make it one.

selected.none: An avatar isn't a control; wrap it in a Button or link to make it one.

error.when: a broken image (React and ayywi/elements set hidden on it)
error.looks: The initials show; with CSS alone the broken-image icon is covered by a plain disc.

loading.none: Initials show until the image loads; use a circle Skeleton only when the name isn't known yet.

sizes.density: Doesn't follow data-density. Initials are 38% of the size.
sizes.width: Square. A group overlaps them by 20% with a page-colour ring.

js: avatarClass({ size?, shape?, className? }); avatarInitials(name); avatarGroupClass, avatarImageClass, avatarFallbackClass constants
a11y: The name goes on the root (aria-label); the has alt="" and the initials are aria-hidden, so it's announced once.
Give an AvatarGroup an aria-label like "5 collaborators".
A failed image is hidden by React or ayywi/elements so the initials show. With CSS alone it renders as a plain disc.
do: Use avatars for people and workspaces in lists, headers and comments.
Use AvatarGroup for a stack of collaborators: show at most 4–5 and a "+3" badge for the rest.
dont: Don't use an avatar for decorative illustrations — use a plain .
Don't use an avatar for icons — use Icon.
Don't rely on the picture alone to identify someone — show the name nearby.
